items.title: Natural Hair Representation in Little: Marsai Martin
items.summary: So the movie Little, written by and starring Marsai Martin, Regina Hall, and Issa (my cousin) Rae came out a few weeks ago and you already know your girl was first in line to see it (ok that’s a lie I went during $5 Tuesday 😩😭). When I first saw the movie trailer, I was ecstatic because my sisters were out here reppin’ in their NATURAL HAIR and clearly, the fans are here for it! The movie lived up to my greatest expectations. Here are all the reasons why I loved this movie! REPRESENTATION. It was very refreshing to see a movie WRITTEN by and STARRING strong, black, influential women! It may not seem like that big of a deal, but this is huge. Representation is such a powerful thing. When people see individuals that look like them embracing their natural hair, they are inspired to wear their hair out. I was living for the hairstyles in this movie! ISSA?? MARSAI?? The random 4C lady that was crying in the corner?? Y’all ain’t see that? Oh I see you sis! Like seriously, does anyone know how I can send her the Full Avocado Collection? 👀 *cough cough* 4C gang stand up 👏🏾 BLACK WOMEN IN TECHNOLOGY. Regina Hall not only stars in this movie, but she is the CEO of a technology company. I’ve seen women represented as bosses in movies like The Devil Wears Prada and The Proposal, but to see a woman that looks like me, talks like me, and dresses like me (jk I’m currently wearing bike shorts) in this role was very inspiring and impactful. JORDAN’S AFRO. Imagine walking into school as a little girl rocking your natural hair only to find out that your classmates had been sticking straws in your hair the entire day. This has to be one of my favorite scenes because Jordan handled the situation well and ignored the bullies. And then she came back like a BOSS with this fun afro with a middle up-do! BLACK GIRL JOY. Now I don’t know about Issa’s outfit, but I am living for the hair, the curls, the dance, and the overall black girl joy in this scene! FRIENDSHIP. I loved the relationship between April and Jordan. At first, it was a little rocky... But as the movie progressed, they were able to form an unbreakable bond. P.S. this picture made me want to take out my braids and rock my fro! Did I mention that there’s a bunch of black women in this movie? Oh I did? Just making sure you heard me. The list could go on and on. I am here for the normalization of natural hair on screen and I am proud of the men and women that are breaking the standards of beauty and what is normal to see on screen. Long story short, me and the snacks I smuggled in had a great time watching this movie and I’ll definitely be seeing it again!

items.title: Ashley's Natural Hair Journey
items.summary: As a new natural I had no idea what I was doing to my hair so I treated it the same as my relaxed hair. Between heat damage, color damage, and over processed hair, my hair became stringy and brittle and I was forced to do the big chop. I was very self conscious about my new short cut until someone suggested I take to YouTube to learn, which is how I came across Muhga and NaturAll Club...

items.title: Member Spotlight: Asia's Natural Hair Journey
items.summary: I've never had a relaxer, however, for the past 24+ years of my life, I've gone through different levels of acceptance, with me only learning to properly care for, style and embrace my hair over the past 6 years. As a young girl, my hair was always braided up, or in the typical styles little Black girls wear with intricate parts and barrettes and bubbles that matched my outfit of the day. Then, from age 12-14 I got a Dominican blowout every two weeks. My hair was sleek, even though braided for most of the time, but little did I know, the looser curl pattern I saw was actually heat damage! Hear the rest of the story...

items.title: Member Spotlight: Kitana's Natural Hair Journey
items.summary: I remember using too much product trying to get rid of my dry and damaged ends/hair. I ended up weighing down my hair, making it worse. Days, months, and years passed, and my hair continued to break off, look really thin, and uneven. I never wanted to deal with it so I always went to salons to get it done because I felt like they would know more about how to handle my hair than I did at the time.

items.title: NEW Avocado Shampoo and Conditioner are here!!
items.summary: You asked and we listened! Gone are the days where you have to buy your shampoo and conditioner elsewhere. We have brought the same superior quality and ingredients from our Deep Conditioners, to bring you the wash day products you have been asking for. We are excited to announce the news of NaturAll Club’s Cleansing Avocado Shampoo and Hydrating Avocado Conditioner! Why Avocado? We love avocado here at NaturAll Club, so we had to extend the line! Avocados are packed with all the nutrients and vitamins your hair needs to grow healthy and strong! Avocado oil is high in monounsaturated fatty acids, which nourish, moisturize, and strengthen hair strands, protecting them from damage. It also contains antioxidants, which protect the hair. These monounsaturated fats also make avocado oil a great solution for individuals with dry or sensitive skin. Avocado oil is able to quickly penetrate into the second layer of the skin (the dermis), providing a deep moisturizing treatment to the scalp. Avocado oil contains vitamin D, which is crucial for the generation of new hair follicles. Use avocado oil on your scalp and throughout your hair to maintain and encourage hair growth! Learn more about avocado oil here. Cleansing Avocado Shampoo NaturAll Club's Cleansing Avocado Shampoo strips away product buildup in your hair for a healthier, bouncier tresses. It also leaves your hair clean and refreshed while maintaining moisture. Our full size, 8oz shampoo sells for $17. This is a shelf-stable product that does not need to be kept refrigerated. Pre-Orders open on 12:00 AM on Wednesday, October 17th! How to use: Beginning on soaking wet hair, gently massage and work the shampoo into your hair. Once your entire head has gotten a complete scrub, rinse thoroughly, then follow up with the Hydrating Avocado Conditioner. Ingredients: We are proud to say that our Cleansing Avocado Shampoo is all-natural! We have hand-selected every ingredients with care to bring you the best results, without including any damaging or toxic ingredients. Below are some ingredients you will find in our shampoo... Caprylhydroxamic Acid (Naturally derived from glucose and coconut) is a safe, naturally-derived preservative that provides gentle anti-microbial protection without compromising your safety or results- in fact, it actually helps moisturize your hair! Decyl Glucoside (Naturally derived from glucose and coconut) is a mild, gentle cleaning agent. It is biodegradable, non-irritating, non-allergenic, and does not dry out the skin or hair. Disodium Cocoamphodipropionate is another cleaning agent (also known as a surfectant.) We use it to remove dirt without stripping your hair. It also enhances the feeling, sheen, and suppleness of your natural hair! Glycerin is a clear, odorless liquid produced from plant oils that has strong humectant properties. Because glycerin attracts moisture, it is well known for its ability to smooth and soften hair. It pulls moisture into the hair cuticles and locks it in, preventing hair from becoming frizzy, dry or breaking off. Learn more about our ingredients here. Hydrating Avocado Conditioner NaturAll Club’s Hydrating Avocado Conditioner uses a combination of natural oils and active ingredients to promote a soft, moisturized and detangled mane! Our full size 12oz bottle sells for $22. This is a shelf-stable product that does not need to be kept refrigerated. Pre-Orders open on 12:00 AM on Wednesday, October 17th! How to use it: After shampooing with the Cleansing Avocado Shampoo, work the conditioner through your hair from roots to ends. Comb or finger detangle your hair in sections, then rinse thoroughly. Ingredients: Our Hydrating Avocado Conditioner is also all natural. We are committed to providing you only the best of the best ingredients! Below are some ingredients you will find in our conditioner: Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil is rich in high levels of monounsaturated fatty acids and Vitamin E, an antioxidant important for hair growth. It also contains anti-inflammatory properties that promote scalp health and prevent dandruff. Butyrospermum Parkii, or Shea butter, is a natural conditioner for hair as it absorbs easily into the scalp and it does not clog the pores! Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride (naturally derived) is one of the best emollients (conditioners) out there! It replenishes skin and hair with moisture and prevents moisture loss, without leaving a greasy residue. It is also a safe and gentle ingredient, great for sensitive skin and fragile hair. Learn more about the rest of our ingredients here. Early feedback... Here are some testimonials from our early customer testing! “The product [shampoo] was very light not too thick like other shampoos I have tried... While washing I actually felt as if I was moisturizing my hair as I was washing which is very rare for me... I didn’t feel as if washing with this would take away moisture as others do.
